sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, the deadliest violence in years has erupted between Israel and Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 过去几天里，以色列和巴勒斯坦之间爆发了多年来最致命的暴力冲突。

sentences.en: Intense rocket fire from Gaza, answered by Israeli airstrikes, showing no sign of easing.
sentences.zh: 来自加沙的密集火箭弹袭击，以及以色列随后的空袭，目前没有任何缓和的迹象。

sentences.en: Punctuated by hundreds of missiles streaking back and forth between Gaza and cities across Israel.
sentences.zh: 加沙与以色列各地城市之间数百枚导弹往来穿梭。

sentences.en: Increasingly large numbers of casualties, including children, from Israeli airstrikes in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以色列对加沙的空袭造成了越来越多的伤亡，其中包括儿童。

sentences.en: And now, on the streets of Israel, by shocking scenes of mob pilots against both Arabs and Jews, today.
sentences.zh: 而今天，在以色列街头，还出现了阿拉伯人和犹太人之间令人震惊的暴徒冲突场面。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague in Jerusalem, Isabel Kirshner, about why it's all happening and just how much worse it may get.
sentences.zh: 我与我在耶路撒冷的同事伊莎贝尔·克什纳谈了谈，了解这一切发生的原因以及局势可能恶化到什么程度。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月13日，星期四。

sentences.en: Isabel, I know there may not be a simple answer to this question, but what was the trigger for this eruption of violence in Jerusalem over the past few weeks?
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，我知道这个问题可能没有简单的答案，但过去几周耶路撒冷暴力冲突爆发的导火索是什么？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: one of the triggers for sure is actually a case of six Palestinian families who are facing a looming eviction by Jewish landlords from their houses that they've been living in since the 1950s in a very small,
sentences.zh: 其中一个导火索无疑是六个巴勒斯坦家庭面临的驱逐案，他们面临着被犹太房东从自20世纪50年代起就一直居住的房子里赶走的威胁，这些房子位于一个非常小、

sentences.en: quiet, leafy neighbourhood of East Jerusalem, not far from the old city.
sentences.zh: 安静且绿树成荫的东耶路撒冷社区，离老城不远。

sentences.en: In the neighbourhood of Sheikh Jarrah, the tension's been growing for weeks.
sentences.zh: 在谢赫贾拉社区，紧张局势已经持续了数周。

sentences.en: Several Palestinian families face eviction from their homes.
sentences.zh: 几个巴勒斯坦家庭面临被驱逐出家园的境地。

sentences.en: We are in the right.
sentences.zh: 我们是正义的一方。

sentences.en: We are still resisting.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在抵抗。

sentences.en: We are staying here, even if they don't want us.
sentences.zh: 即使他们不欢迎我们，我们也会留在这里。

sentences.en: This is a case that's been bubbling on for years and years.
sentences.zh: 这是一个已经酝酿了多年的案件。

sentences.en: We don't understand why Arabs are here.
sentences.zh: 我们不明白为什么阿拉伯人会在这里。

sentences.en: I don't want any problems, but this land is Jewish and belongs to us.
sentences.zh: 我不想惹麻烦，但这片土地是犹太人的，属于我们。

sentences.en: We don't believe anyone, not the courts or anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们不相信任何人，无论是法院还是其他人。

sentences.en: The Israeli government has cast it as a small private real estate dispute, but it's far from that.
sentences.zh: 以色列政府将其描述为一个小型的私人房地产纠纷，但事实远非如此。

sentences.en: You're talking about families who were displaced and made refugees during 1948, the war surrounding the creation of Israel, and they lost their homes in what became Israel.
sentences.zh: 你所说的是那些在1948年以色列建国战争期间流离失所并成为难民的家庭，他们在后来成为以色列领土的地方失去了家园。

sentences.en: And they moved to that area of East Jerusalem when the Jordanians were in control.
sentences.zh: 当约旦人控制东耶路撒冷时，他们搬到了那个地区。

sentences.en: And the Jordanian government actually offered them an option in conjunction with the United Nations Refugee Agency at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时约旦政府实际上与联合国难民署合作，为他们提供了一个选择。

sentences.en: They said, we'll build some houses in this neighbourhood, a few dozen houses, and you can come live in them,
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们会在这个社区建一些房子，几十栋房子，你们可以搬进去住，

sentences.en: and we will register them for you, and in return you should give up your refugee status.
sentences.zh: 我们会为你们登记，作为交换，你们应该放弃难民身份。

sentences.en: And the families actually agreed to that and moved into the houses.
sentences.zh: 这些家庭实际上同意了这一点并搬进了房子。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, somehow the Jordanian government never actually finally registered them in their names.
sentences.zh: 但最终，不知何故，约旦政府从未真正以他们的名义进行最终登记。

sentences.en: So then, in 1967, the Middle East war breaks out, and Jordan loses control of the land of East Jerusalem, and Israel takes control of it.
sentences.zh: 后来，1967年中东战争爆发，约旦失去了对东耶路撒冷土地的控制，以色列接管了它。

sentences.en: Israel, after the 1967 war, annexed that territory, but that move was never internationally recognised.
sentences.zh: 1967年战争后，以色列吞并了该领土，但这一举动从未得到国际承认。

sentences.en: And most of the world still considers it occupied territory.
sentences.zh: 世界上大多数国家仍然认为这是被占领土。

sentences.en: And although there was an agreement between the Jordanians and these Palestinian families over these homes, the land they sit on now gets to be controlled by Israel.
sentences.zh: 尽管约旦人和这些巴勒斯坦家庭之间曾就这些房屋达成过协议，但他们所居住的土地现在由以色列控制。

sentences.en: And on top of that, although this is now a Palestinian-populated area predominantly, the land was bought by a Jewish trust in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，尽管这里现在主要是巴勒斯坦人居住区，但这片土地是在19世纪由一个犹太信托机构购买的。

sentences.en: And then, in the meantime, religious trusts have sold the rights to a real estate agency, people who want to move Jews back into that neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，宗教信托机构已将权利出售给了一家房地产中介，这些人希望将犹太人迁回那个社区。

sentences.en: And there is nothing more in the Palestinian mindset, nothing more upsetting than the refugee issue.
sentences.zh: 在巴勒斯坦人的心态中，没有什么比难民问题更令人不安的了。

sentences.en: So it just took on much bigger proportions.
sentences.zh: 所以这件事的影响范围变得大得多了。

sentences.en: You know, it's not just about renting or an eviction order or a few houses.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不仅仅是关于租金、驱逐令或几栋房子的事。

sentences.en: It suddenly becomes a national issue.
sentences.zh: 它突然变成了一个民族问题。

sentences.en: So this is pretty complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以这相当复杂。

sentences.en: But to summarise, these refugee Palestinian families were given these homes in the 1950s and told that it would be their home for good.
sentences.zh: 但总而言之，这些巴勒斯坦难民家庭在20世纪50年代获得了这些房屋，并被告知这将是他们永久的家。

sentences.en: But that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It's still the case that legally these homes belong to Jewish landlords.
sentences.zh: 法律上，这些房屋仍然属于犹太房东。

sentences.en: And now those Jewish landlords are saying to these Palestinian families, we want you out.
sentences.zh: 现在那些犹太房东对这些巴勒斯坦家庭说，我们要你们搬走。

sentences.en: And in part, they want them out because they want Jewish people to control these properties in East Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们想赶走他们是因为他们希望犹太人控制东耶路撒冷的这些房产。

sentences.en: Well, that's correct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: And they're able to do that based on a 1970s law, which allows Jewish property owners to reclaim property in the east side of the city.
sentences.zh: 他们能够这样做是基于20世纪70年代的一项法律，该法律允许犹太业主收回城市东部的房产。

sentences.en: But, you know, then on the other side, the Palestinians do not have the same recourse to reclaim properties they left on the west side of the city or elsewhere in Israel.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，另一方面，巴勒斯坦人却没有同样的追索权来收回他们在城市西部或以色列其他地方留下的房产。

sentences.en: So this has created a huge imbalance.
sentences.zh: 所以这造成了巨大的不平衡。

sentences.en: And the dispute has gone from the district court all the way up to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 这场纠纷已经从地方法院一直打到了最高法院。

sentences.en: And we were waiting for a final verdict in the case of whether the evictions would go ahead or not on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们原本在等待周一就驱逐令是否会执行的最终判决。

sentences.en: So Isabel, how does this legal conflict over these evictions spiral into what we are seeing now?
sentences.zh: 那么伊莎贝尔，这场关于驱逐的法律冲突是如何演变成我们现在看到的局面的？

sentences.en: How does that happen?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Okay, good question.
sentences.zh: 好的，好问题。

sentences.en: Because there are many, many other strands to this story.
sentences.zh: 因为这个故事还有许多许多其他的线索。

sentences.en: And I think one thing we have to look at is the calendar.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须关注的一个因素是时间表。

sentences.en: We have been in a month that has been extraordinary in many ways.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了一个在许多方面都非同寻常的月份。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, we've had the month of Ramadan in the Islamic lunar calendar.
sentences.zh: 一方面，我们经历了伊斯兰农历中的斋月。

sentences.en: And Ramadan, the lunar calendar, it moves.
sentences.zh: 而斋月，即农历，是会变动的。

sentences.en: So this year, Ramadan fell from mid-April to now.
sentences.zh: 所以今年，斋月从4月中旬一直持续到现在。

sentences.en: So it also coincided with a month in the Hebrew calendar when you also have quite a lot of emotive dates.
sentences.zh: 它恰好与希伯来历中的一个月重合，那个月也有很多充满情感的日子。

sentences.en: You have the Memorial Day for fallen soldiers.
sentences.zh: 有阵亡将士纪念日。

sentences.en: You have the Independence Day.
sentences.zh: 有独立日。

sentences.en: You get towards the end of the month and you get Jerusalem Day,
sentences.zh: 到了月底，还有耶路撒冷日，

sentences.en: which is the day when some Israelis, not all, are celebrating what they call the reunification of Jerusalem in the 1967 war.
sentences.zh: 这一天，一些（并非全部）以色列人会庆祝他们所谓的1967年战争中耶路撒冷的统一。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a day where the Israelis are marking conquering the eastern part of the city, placing the Palestinians in the city, generally on the other side of the line,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这一天是以色列人纪念征服城市东部、将巴勒斯坦人置于城市中（通常是在界线的另一边）的日子，

sentences.en: in what became occupied East Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 也就是后来成为被占领的东耶路撒冷的地方。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And that can be a very provocative day as well, because a central feature of it is what they call the flag parade,
sentences.zh: 那也可能是一个非常挑衅的日子，因为它的一个核心特征是他们所谓的“旗帜游行”，

sentences.en: which is usually thousands of young right-wing, mostly Jewish youths, who march traditionally on a very contentious route,
sentences.zh: 通常有成千上万名年轻的右翼、主要是犹太青年参加，他们传统上会沿着一条非常有争议的路线行进，

sentences.en: right through the Muslim quarter of the old city to get to the Wailing Wall.
sentences.zh: 穿过老城的穆斯林区前往哭墙。

sentences.en: And, of course, that was supposed to happen also on, yes, you guessed it, Monday.
sentences.zh: 当然，这本也应该在——是的，你猜对了——周一发生。

sentences.en: So Monday of this past week becomes, through the eviction case and through the calendar, a kind of swirling collision of Palestinian grief and Israeli celebration
sentences.zh: 所以，过去这一周的周一，通过驱逐案和时间表，变成了一种巴勒斯坦人的悲痛与以色列人的庆祝相互碰撞的漩涡，

sentences.en: and just a kind of powder keg, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像一个火药桶。

sentences.en: And we also had a lot else going on in the city building up to this day.
sentences.zh: 而且在这一天之前，城里还发生了很多其他事情。

sentences.en: Ramadan is a time when the city is very much on edge.
sentences.zh: 斋月期间，城市非常紧张。

sentences.en: It's a time of, you know, religious and nationalist fervor for many people.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，这是一个充满宗教和民族主义狂热的时期。

sentences.en: And it started with several other potential points of ignition.
sentences.zh: 它始于其他几个潜在的引爆点。

sentences.en: So you had the police, for example, barring Palestinians from gathering at Damascus Gate.
sentences.zh: 例如，警方禁止巴勒斯坦人在大马士革门聚集。

sentences.en: Damascus Gate is one of the most beautiful and historic entrances to the old city from the east side.
sentences.zh: 大马士革门是从东侧进入老城最美丽、最具历史意义的入口之一。

sentences.en: And it has these steps and going down to a plaza, a bit like a kind of amphitheater.
sentences.zh: 它有台阶通向一个广场，有点像露天剧场。

sentences.en: And every night during Ramadan, traditionally, every year, Palestinians come, they gather there, they break their fast, there are cultural events.
sentences.zh: 每年斋月期间，巴勒斯坦人传统上每晚都会来这里聚集、开斋，并举办文化活动。

sentences.en: And it's a general kind of party, a festival atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 这通常是一种聚会，一种节日氛围。

sentences.en: But for some reason this year, the police banned anyone from gathering and sitting on the steps.
sentences.zh: 但不知为何今年，警方禁止任何人聚集并坐在台阶上。

sentences.en: They put up barricades and said it was for public order to allow people to safely enter and exit the old city.
sentences.zh: 他们设置了路障，称这是为了公共秩序，以便让人们安全地进出老城。

sentences.en: And this created huge tension.
sentences.zh: 这造成了巨大的紧张局势。

sentences.en: So it actually turned into a battlefield.
sentences.zh: 所以它实际上变成了一个战场。

sentences.en: Every night you would have the police trying to disperse the crowds there.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，警察都会试图驱散那里的人群。

sentences.en: Young Palestinians would protest and it would end in clashes.
sentences.zh: 年轻的巴勒斯坦人会抗议，最终演变成冲突。

sentences.en: We also had what became known as the TikTok attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们还经历了后来被称为“TikTok袭击”的事件。

sentences.en: What are those?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: So there were a couple of Palestinian 17-year-old youths who filmed themselves for a TikTok video slapping an ultra-Orthodox Jew while he was sitting on the light rail train.
sentences.zh: 有几个17岁的巴勒斯坦青年拍摄了一段TikTok视频，内容是扇了一名坐在轻轨列车上的极端正统派犹太人耳光。

sentences.en: And it kind of went viral.
sentences.zh: 视频在网上疯传。

sentences.en: And there were one or two other similar attacks.
sentences.zh: 还有一两次类似的袭击。

sentences.en: And people just took great affront.
sentences.zh: 人们感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And it ended up with hundreds of young Israeli Jews marching to Damascus Gate, chanting things including death to Arabs.
sentences.zh: 最终导致数百名年轻的以色列犹太人游行到大马士革门，高呼包括“阿拉伯人去死”在内的口号。

sentences.en: And in the end you had the police acting as a buffer between them and the Palestinian protesters at Damascus Gate.
sentences.zh: 最后，警察在大马士革门充当了他们与巴勒斯坦抗议者之间的缓冲力量。

sentences.en: And, you know, pitched battles on both sides with the police.
sentences.zh: 双方都与警察发生了激烈的冲突。

sentences.en: So that was one other strand of great tension building up towards this Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以这是导致周一紧张局势加剧的另一个因素。

sentences.en: So a very unstable situation is very much ignited by actions taken by multiple groups of people on the ground in Jerusalem, including the Israeli police.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个非常不稳定的局势，很大程度上是被耶路撒冷当地多方群体（包括以色列警方）采取的行动所点燃的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we come to Monday morning after all this build-up of all these different tensions in the city in this very tense month.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这一个月里城市中所有这些不同紧张局势的积累后，我们来到了周一早上。

sentences.en: And we get to the point where we've had Leila til Qadr, which is a very holy day for Muslims at the end of Ramadan,
sentences.zh: 我们到了“盖德尔之夜”，这是斋月结束时穆斯林的一个非常神圣的日子，

sentences.en: when thousands of worshippers spend the night traditionally in the compound of the Aqsa Mosque, which is the third holiest site in Islam.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的信徒传统上会在阿克萨清真寺大院度过夜晚，这是伊斯兰教第三大圣地。

sentences.en: And it's also probably one of the most hotly contested sites in the world because it's also the holiest place for Jews.
sentences.zh: 它也可能是世界上争议最激烈的地点之一，因为它也是犹太人最神圣的地方。

sentences.en: They know it as Temple Mount, and it's the location of two ancient temples.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为圣殿山，这里是两座古代圣殿的所在地。

sentences.en: So on Monday morning, which is Jerusalem Day as well, there were Jewish groups who were planning, as they traditionally do, to go up to the Temple Mount on a visit.
sentences.zh: 所以周一早上，也就是耶路撒冷日，有犹太团体计划像往常一样去圣殿山参观。

sentences.en: And the Muslim worshippers, many of whom, as I say, had been there overnight,
sentences.zh: 而穆斯林信徒，正如我所说，许多人已经在那里过夜了，

sentences.en: were expecting them ready for, you know, what they would see as a kind of invasion on their holy territory on a very holy time of year.
sentences.zh: 他们做好了准备，迎接他们眼中在一年中非常神圣的时刻对他们圣地的“入侵”。

sentences.en: The police stopped the Jewish groups from going up.
sentences.zh: 警方阻止了犹太团体上去。

sentences.en: But what we did see was the police, in large numbers, raid the compound.
sentences.zh: 但我们看到的是，大量警察突袭了大院。

sentences.en: There are many different takes on whether they went in just to disperse crowds, or they went in to stop stone-throwing by protesters at the site that had already started,
sentences.zh: 关于他们进去是为了驱散人群，还是为了阻止抗议者在现场已经开始的投掷石块行为，

sentences.en: or whether the stones only started after the police arrived.
sentences.zh: 或者石块是在警察到达后才开始投掷的，有许多不同的说法。

sentences.en: But whatever the exact circumstances, you ended up with a large police raid on the Aksamos compound.
sentences.zh: 但无论具体情况如何，最终导致了大规模警察突袭阿克萨清真寺大院。

sentences.en: And it ended in stone-throwing clashes, with police responding with tear gas, rubber-tip bullets, stun grenades.
sentences.zh: 最终演变成了投掷石块的冲突，警察以催泪瓦斯、橡胶子弹和眩晕弹作为回应。

sentences.en: And by the end of the main part of this confrontation, you have, on the one side, 330 Palestinians who've been injured,
sentences.zh: 在这次对抗的主要部分结束时，一方面有330名巴勒斯坦人受伤，

sentences.en: 250 who were actually treated in the hospitals.
sentences.zh: 其中250人在医院接受了治疗。

sentences.en: And on the other side, 21 police officers injured.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，有21名警察受伤。

sentences.en: So, Isabel, what happens after this police raid on the mosque?
sentences.zh: 那么伊莎贝尔，警察突袭清真寺后发生了什么？

sentences.en: How do Palestinians respond?
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人是如何回应的？

sentences.en: So, by the afternoon, we get an ultimatum from Hamas, the Islamic group that holds sway in Gaza, saying if the Israelis do not remove all their forces from the mosque compound
sentences.zh: 到了下午，哈马斯（加沙的伊斯兰组织）发出最后通牒，称如果以色列人不从清真寺大院撤出所有部队，

sentences.en: and from the area of East Jerusalem, the Palestinian area where the evictions were about to take place, something would happen.
sentences.zh: 也不从东耶路撒冷（即将发生驱逐事件的巴勒斯坦地区）撤出，就会发生一些事情。

sentences.en: And they don't specify what that something is, but it will be serious.
sentences.zh: 他们没有具体说明那是什么事情，但会很严重。

sentences.en: Israel will be paying the price.
sentences.zh: 以色列将付出代价。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅用户每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Isabel, what happens on Monday with this 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 那么伊莎贝尔，周一哈马斯设定的下午6点最后期限，要求以色列安全部队从东耶路撒冷和清真寺撤出，结果如何？

sentences.en: deadline from Hamas for Israeli security forces to withdraw from East Jerusalem and from the mosque?
sentences.zh: 显然，以色列人不会遵守。

sentences.en: Well, clearly, the Israelis were not going to comply.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们一直等到六点。

sentences.en: So, we waited till six o'clock.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，六点零三分，我们坐在耶路撒冷的办公室里，

sentences.en: And lo and behold, three minutes past six, we're sitting here in our office in Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 突然听到警报声大作，那是火箭弹来袭的预警。

sentences.en: And suddenly, we hear sirens wailing, incoming rocket warnings.
sentences.zh: 不到一分钟，我们突然听到了一连串的爆炸声。

sentences.en: And within maybe a minute, we suddenly hear a series of booMs.
sentences.zh: （注：此条对应原字幕第149条，已翻译）

sentences.en: You know, there's a feeling that Jerusalem is under attack.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们有一种感觉，耶路撒冷正受到攻击。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, once this deadline passes, Hamas sends missiles over into Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 所以，一旦最后期限过去，哈马斯就会向耶路撒冷发射导弹。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They're aiming towards Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: One was intercepted by Israel's Iron Dome, the anti-missile defense system.
sentences.zh: 其中一枚被以色列的“铁穹”反导防御系统拦截了。

sentences.en: Others actually fell in communities and empty ground in the hills west of Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 其他的则落在了耶路撒冷以西山区的社区和空地上。

sentences.en: And nobody was killed or hurt, but there was some property damage.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有人伤亡，但造成了一些财产损失。

sentences.en: And this was highly unusual and clearly was not going to go without an Israeli response.
sentences.zh: 这种情况非常罕见，显然以色列不可能不做出回应。

sentences.en: And what is that response?
sentences.zh: 那回应是什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, Israel had clearly been anticipating some kind of action from Gaza and always has what it calls a bank of targets that it's built up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，以色列显然一直在预料加沙方面会采取某种行动，并且一直有一个所谓的“目标库”，是他们长期积累起来的。

sentences.en: And Israel immediately began with airstrikes in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以色列随即开始对加沙进行空袭。

sentences.en: And now, Gaza is a very small and crowded territory.
sentences.zh: 加沙是一个非常狭小且拥挤的地区。

sentences.en: So, even if Israel says it's targeting military targets with very precise weapons and taking all
sentences.zh: 所以，即使以色列声称他们是用精确武器打击军事目标，并尽其所能采取了

sentences.en: the precautions it can to avoid civilian casualties, inevitably, there are civilian casualties as well.
sentences.zh: 一切预防措施来避免平民伤亡，但不可避免地，还是会有平民伤亡。

sentences.en: So, from the beginning, the airstrikes were deadly.
sentences.zh: 因此，从一开始，空袭就是致命的。

sentences.en: There were two children killed very early on that night and each side just kept stepping it up.
sentences.zh: 那天很早就有两名儿童丧生，双方都在不断升级冲突。

sentences.en: Israel taking down tower blocks in Gaza, multi-story buildings that housed Hamas offices or headquarters of various types of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 以色列摧毁了加沙的塔楼，那些多层建筑里设有哈马斯的办公室或各种类型的指挥部。

sentences.en: And Hamas again issued another ultimatum and said to Israel, if you hit any more civilian buildings, we're going to hit Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯再次发出最后通牒，告诉以色列：如果你再袭击任何平民建筑，我们就袭击特拉维夫。

sentences.en: And a huge, huge salvo, barrages of rockets began streaming out of Gaza and slamming into suburbs around Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: 随后，大量火箭弹从加沙倾泻而出，猛烈轰击特拉维夫周边的郊区。

sentences.en: You know, things have just been escalating all the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，局势一直在不断升级。

sentences.en: So, by Wednesday afternoon, two days into the conflict, we have at least 53 Palestinians killed, according to the Gaza health officials,
sentences.zh: 所以，到周三下午，冲突进入第二天，据加沙卫生官员称，至少有53名巴勒斯坦人死亡，

sentences.en: 14 of them children and more than 300 wounded.
sentences.zh: 其中14人是儿童，另有300多人受伤。

sentences.en: And on the Israeli side, you have at least six people who've been killed and, you know, scores injured.
sentences.zh: 而在以色列方面，至少有6人死亡，还有许多人受伤。

sentences.en: Isabel, it is often felt in moments like this that Hamas's missile attacks, as terrifying as they are to Israelis,
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，在这样的时刻，人们常觉得哈马斯的导弹袭击虽然让以色列人感到恐惧，

sentences.en: often fail to inflict significant damage on Israel based on the technology that Hamas is using.
sentences.zh: 但基于哈马斯所使用的技术，往往无法对以色列造成重大破坏。

sentences.en: And that the Israeli counterattacks tend to be much better targeted and more destructive.
sentences.zh: 而以色列的反击往往目标更精准，破坏力也更大。

sentences.en: And the death toll seems to suggest that that has been the case so far here, a kind of disproportionate impact.
sentences.zh: 目前的死亡人数似乎也印证了这一点，这是一种不成比例的影响。

sentences.en: Look, disproportionate is a term that, you know, is often used.
sentences.zh: 听着，“不成比例”这个词确实经常被用到。

sentences.en: I think there's certainly the circumstances that Israel has total air superiority in terms of its air force.
sentences.zh: 我认为，以色列在空军方面拥有绝对的空中优势，这确实是客观情况。

sentences.en: The Hamas rockets are rather inaccurate.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯的火箭弹相当不精准。

sentences.en: Israel does have the Iron Dome system, which manages to intercept the authorities, say, about 90 percent of rockets that are headed to population centers in Israel.
sentences.zh: 以色列确实拥有“铁穹”系统，据官方称，该系统成功拦截了约90%射向以色列人口密集区的火箭弹。

sentences.en: But the Gaza Strip is just, first of all, very crowded, very densely populated.
sentences.zh: 但首先，加沙地带非常拥挤，人口密度极高。

sentences.en: The Israelis will tell you that Hamas operates from civilian areas within Gaza, making it very, very, very difficult to avoid collateral damage.
sentences.zh: 以色列人会告诉你，哈马斯是在加沙的平民区内进行活动，这使得避免附带损害变得非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: At this point, is it fair to describe what's happening here as a war, as warlike?
sentences.zh: 目前，将这里发生的事情描述为战争或类战争状态，公平吗？

sentences.en: What is this?
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么？

sentences.en: It feels pretty warlike.
sentences.zh: 感觉确实很像战争。

sentences.en: If we end up with a ground campaign on the Israeli forces side, it will definitely be a war.
sentences.zh: 如果我们最终看到以色列军队发动地面行动，那绝对就是战争了。

sentences.en: And is there talk of a ground operation?
sentences.zh: 有关于地面行动的讨论吗？

sentences.en: Well, no confirmation of one, but some preparations seem to be being made.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还没有得到证实，但似乎正在进行一些准备工作。

sentences.en: There are some call-ups of reserves.
sentences.zh: 已经征召了一些预备役人员。

sentences.en: There are some troops and vehicles moving down towards the border.
sentences.zh: 一些部队和车辆正在向边境移动。

sentences.en: So it's not being ruled out.
sentences.zh: 所以这并没有被排除。

sentences.en: But it's hard to tell.
sentences.zh: 但很难说。

sentences.en: I think Israel won't rush into a ground invasion because they are usually very costly.
sentences.zh: 我认为以色列不会急于发动地面入侵，因为这通常代价高昂。

sentences.en: But sometimes, you know, it's part of the tactical war to signal that you're ready for one, which could also be what's going on.
sentences.zh: 但有时，你知道，这也是战术战争的一部分，即发出准备发动地面进攻的信号，这可能也是目前正在发生的情况。

sentences.en: What are the leaders on all sides of this saying about this moment and how it might come to an end?
sentences.zh: 冲突各方的领导人对此有何评价？他们认为这会如何结束？

sentences.en: I realize that's a tricky question because both the Israeli and Palestinian leadership is very much in flux.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是一个棘手的问题，因为以色列和巴勒斯坦的领导层都处于极不稳定的状态。

sentences.en: But what are they saying about it?
sentences.zh: 但他们对此是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: So we heard on Wednesday night a very strong statement from President Mahmoud Abbas.
sentences.zh: 我们在周三晚上听到了马哈茂德·阿巴斯总统非常强硬的声明。

sentences.en: He leads the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank and is a main rival of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 他领导着约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦权力机构，是哈马斯的主要竞争对手。

sentences.en: And he was basically telling Israel, end your occupation.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在告诉以色列：结束你们的占领。

sentences.en: And we've been hearing more from Hamas.
sentences.zh: 我们也听到了更多来自哈马斯的声音。

sentences.en: So Ismail Haniyah, a senior Hamas political leader, sent a recorded address to a Hamas-affiliated television station.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯高级政治领导人伊斯梅尔·哈尼亚向一家哈马斯附属电视台发送了一段录音讲话。

sentences.en: He spoke about being contacted by Egypt, Qatar, the United Nations, with some kind of talk of maybe working towards a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 他提到埃及、卡塔尔和联合国已经与他联系，讨论了可能致力于停火的问题。

sentences.en: But he said, since, in his view, Israel had started this, it was Israel's responsibility to be the ones to begin to end it.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，在他看来，既然是以色列挑起了这一切，那么以色列就有责任率先结束它。

sentences.en: On the Israeli side, we're hearing that we're not done yet.
sentences.zh: 在以色列方面，我们听到的是：我们还没结束。

sentences.en: The defense minister said on Wednesday there's no end date.
sentences.zh: 国防部长周三表示，没有结束日期。

sentences.en: And the night before, the prime minister also said, you know, this could take some time.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，总理也表示，这可能需要一些时间。

sentences.en: So it sounds like from leadership, there's not an eagerness to quickly bring this to an end.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，领导层并不急于迅速结束这场冲突。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It does seem that on both sides, they're not rushing to end this.
sentences.zh: 双方似乎确实都不急于结束这一切。

sentences.en: And it might actually be helping them.
sentences.zh: 而且这实际上可能对他们有利。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: On the Palestinian side, you have Hamas operating really in a vacuum with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas, who's aging and weak.
sentences.zh: 在巴勒斯坦方面，哈马斯实际上是在权力真空状态下运作，因为巴勒斯坦总统马哈茂德·阿巴斯年事已高且软弱无力。

sentences.en: And Hamas really trying to reinstate itself using its currency of leading the resistance and defending Jerusalem, which is, you know, always a rallying cry on the Palestinian side.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯正试图利用其“领导抵抗”和“保卫耶路撒冷”的筹码来重塑自身，这在巴勒斯坦方面一直是一个号召力极强的口号。

sentences.en: And on the Israeli side, you have a very confused situation because Prime Minister Netanyahu is currently standing trial on corruption charges.
sentences.zh: 而在以色列方面，情况非常混乱，因为总理内塔尼亚胡目前正因腐败指控受审。

sentences.en: He has been unable to form a government after four elections in two years.
sentences.zh: 他在两年内进行了四次选举后，仍未能组建政府。

sentences.en: And his rivals were working on trying to form an alternative coalition, which would have seen him removed from office for the first time in 12 years.
sentences.zh: 他的竞争对手们正致力于组建一个替代联盟，这将使他12年来首次被免职。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, we're not sure how this is going to play out.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们还不确定事态会如何发展。

sentences.en: But somehow he might well be able to capitalize on this time as being not the right time to have a change in government.
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，他很可能会利用这段时间，宣称现在不是更换政府的好时机。

sentences.en: Isabel, we started this conversation by talking about the eviction case in East Jerusalem that, in many people's eyes, lit the fuse that has now turned into this war-like conflict.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，我们开始这段对话时谈到了东耶路撒冷的驱逐案，在许多人看来，这正是点燃这场战争冲突的导火索。

sentences.en: What has happened with that ruling?
sentences.zh: 那个裁决结果怎么样了？

sentences.en: So the ruling was supposed to come on Monday.
sentences.zh: 裁决原定于周一做出。

sentences.en: On Sunday, after the government had spent, you know, weeks saying this is just a private real estate dispute,
sentences.zh: 周日，在政府花了数周时间声称这只是私人房地产纠纷之后，

sentences.en: the attorney general finally stepped in and asked for a delay in the case so that he could study the materials, get involved, state an opinion.
sentences.zh: 总检察长终于介入，要求推迟案件审理，以便他能研究材料、参与其中并发表意见。

sentences.en: And the judges gave him a month suspending the verdict for at least 30 days.
sentences.zh: 法官给了他一个月的时间，将裁决至少推迟了30天。

sentences.en: This is one case where the Israelis stepped in to try and defuse the situation, but of course it was too little too late.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列介入试图缓和局势的一个案例，但当然，这已经太迟了。

sentences.en: So this ruling has been delayed, but not for all that long.
sentences.zh: 所以这个裁决被推迟了，但时间不会太长。

sentences.en: And eventually, when it comes out, it will no doubt influence the course of this conflict that has erupted over the past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 最终，当裁决出炉时，无疑会影响过去几周爆发的这场冲突的进程。

sentences.en: But it strikes me as odd and maybe a bit ironic that the Israeli government has called this eviction case a real estate dispute,
sentences.zh: 但我感到奇怪，甚至有点讽刺的是，以色列政府将这起驱逐案称为“房地产纠纷”，

sentences.en: when you could argue that the entire history of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is ultimately a dispute over real estate, over land, and over the idea of home.
sentences.zh: 而你可以说，整个巴以冲突的历史归根结底就是一场关于房地产、土地以及“家”的概念的纠纷。

sentences.en: You certainly could see it that way.
sentences.zh: 你当然可以这样看。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, with all the security and national and religious aspects to this conflict that's been going on for a century,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，考虑到这场持续了一个世纪的冲突中所有的安全、民族和宗教因素，

sentences.en: at the end of the day, it's about who rules territory where and who gets to call a place home.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，问题在于谁统治哪片领土，以及谁有权称某个地方为家。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Isabel, as always, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，一如既往，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: The Times reports that as the conflict expands, rival mobs of Jews and Arabs are carrying out violent attacks in several Israeli cities and towns.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，随着冲突扩大，犹太人和阿拉伯人的敌对暴徒正在以色列的多个城市和城镇进行暴力袭击。

sentences.en: One occurred in a suburb of Tel Aviv, where dozens of Jewish extremists took turns beating and kicking an Arab motorcycle driver, even as his body lay motionless on the ground.
sentences.zh: 其中一起发生在特拉维夫郊区，数十名犹太极端分子轮流殴打和踢踹一名阿拉伯摩托车手，即使他的身体已瘫倒在地，一动不动。

sentences.en: Another occurred in northern Israel, where an Arab mob beat a Jewish man with sticks and rocks, leaving him in critical condition.
sentences.zh: 另一起发生在以色列北部，一群阿拉伯暴徒用棍棒和石块殴打一名犹太男子，使其伤势危急。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the United Nations warned that the conflict could soon intensify into, quote, all-out war,
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，联合国警告称，冲突可能很快升级为所谓的“全面战争”，

sentences.en: and the Biden administration dispatched a senior American diplomat to the Middle East to meet with Israeli and Palestinian leaders and to urge both sides to de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府派遣了一名高级美国外交官前往中东，会见以色列和巴勒斯坦领导人，敦促双方缓和局势。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, during a closed-door vote, House Republicans ousted Representative Liz Cheney as their party's third-highest-ranking leader
sentences.zh: 周三，在一次闭门投票中，众议院共和党人罢免了众议员利兹·切尼作为该党第三号领导人的职务，

sentences.en: over her decision to speak out against former President Trump, his role in the January 6th riot at the Capitol, and his lies about fraud in the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 原因在于她决定公开反对前总统特朗普，反对他在1月6日国会骚乱中的角色，以及他关于2020年选举舞弊的谎言。

sentences.en: I will do everything I can to ensure that the former president never again gets anywhere near the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 我将尽我所能，确保前总统永远无法再接近椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: After the vote, Cheney said she had no regrets and vowed that she would continue to speak out against Trump and seek to break his hold over the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 投票后，切尼表示她并不后悔，并誓言将继续公开反对特朗普，并寻求打破他对共和党的控制。

sentences.en: We have seen the danger that he continues to provoke with his language.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了他继续用言论煽动危险。

sentences.en: We have seen his lack of commitment and dedication to the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了他对宪法缺乏承诺和奉献精神。

sentences.en: And the company that operates the major fuel pipeline shut down by a cyber attack said that the pipeline's operations had begun to resume.
sentences.zh: 而因网络攻击而关闭的主要燃料管道的运营商表示，管道运营已开始恢复。

sentences.en: The shutdown of the pipeline had raised fears of gas shortages and triggered panicked buying in several states, including Florida, Georgia, and Alabama.
sentences.zh: 管道的关闭引发了人们对汽油短缺的担忧，并在包括佛罗里达州、佐治亚州和阿拉巴马州在内的多个州引发了恐慌性购买。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Austin Mitchell, Soraya Shockley, Robert Jimison, Annie Brown, and Daniel Guimet.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由奥斯汀·米切尔、索拉亚·肖克利、罗伯特·吉米森、安妮·布朗和丹尼尔·吉梅特制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.戴维斯-林恩编辑，菲利斯·弗莱彻提供协助。

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn with help from Phyllis Fletcher.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作，包含罗谢尔·邦贾和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: It was engineered by Chris Wood and contains original music by Rochelle Bonja and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？
